'''Orax Tazaene''' was an individual who served as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
[[File:RancorsTooth.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Orax Tazaene's vessel, the ''Rancor's Tooth'', helped establish the Rebel base on Hoth]]
Orax Tazaene commissioned the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Rancor's Tooth]]''. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Tazaene transferred into service as a [[Rebel privateer|privateer]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="CSWE" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Tazaene's [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was used to help establish the [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel base]] on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|hoth|Hoth}}</ref> of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="CSWE" />
